notes.title: Patch 1.2 (UI improvements)
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
A few improvements of how the UI system works, making the UI almost entirely usable with controller (except for the options, sorry), and adding some quality of life improvements.

[list]
[*] Makes the Level Select Menu entirely interactable with the Controller / Arrow-Keys, avoiding the need for a mouse
[*] Options choices are now saved (including Fullscreen/Windowed)
[*] If you return to the menu after finishing a level it won't force you to repeat the level next time
[*] Stops the pause menu from highlighting the last button pressed when opened, instead defaulting to the Resume/Next Level button
[/list]

[i]Special thanks to Jett Williams for the rigorous bug-testing! Go Wishlist his new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433800/Moonbrella/]Moonbrella[/url]![/i]

[b]Future Schemes: [/b]
If there's any new bugs please let me know and I'll try and fix em' quickly! 

In the medium-term, at some point I'd like to add in a palette swap system, and add some steam integration for achievements (though I'll try to make it work retroactively)!

In the longer term, at some point I may get the desire to make some more levels, but that will partially depend on if there is enough interest (so tell your friends haha)!

notes.title: First Minor Patch
notes.content:
I realised the goals in a couple of the levels were nearly impossible, so I tweaked them slightly!

[list]
[*] Changed the target time in level 6-5 "Beetle" to be 6 rather than 5
[*] Changed the target bounces in level 6-9 "Trawler" to be 7 rather than 5
[/list]
